page.overview:
Who is Piglin?

Hard: to Ranged :Easy and Normal: to Hard: to Melee : Easy: Normal: Hard: Melee : Easy: Normal: Hard: Melee attack without weapon (If crossbow is broken): Easy: Normal: Hard:

A piglin is a neutral mob found in the Nether. It is hostile to players unless they wear at least one piece of golden armor. It can be given gold ingots to barter for various items. It wields either a golden sword, a golden spear or a crossbow, and uses either melee or ranged attacks, respectively.

Baby piglins do not grow up, are passive, and pick up gold without giving anything in return.

Piglins spawn in groups of 2-4 in nether wastes and crimson forest biomes, and within bastion remnants upon generation, at a light level of 11 or less , or 7 or less on most blocks other than nether wart blocks or magma blocks. , they can naturally spawn even in Peaceful difficulty. Each piglin has a 20% or 5% chance of spawning as a baby.

Also known as: Piglins.
